'''Sofia''' is an NPC that appears in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]].

From 6:00 AM to 11:59 AM, she can be seen talking with [[Bellano]]. Meanwhile, from 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM, she can be seen talking with [[Lyubov]] and [[Sergio]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;<nowiki>(6:00 AM to 11:59 AM)</nowiki>
:'''Sofia:''' Hey, Bellano, can't you sell these [[Til the Fin-ish|two little fish]] separately?
:'''Bellano:''' No can do. Once these two fish start kissing, they're inseparable!
:'''Bellano:''' If you try to force them apart, the meat will instantly turn rancid.
:'''Sofia:''' ...I wonder if Riccioli is full of these strange creatures.
:'''Bellano:''' You know what? We used to call them "Die Hard Lovers!"
:'''Bellano:''' The longer they lock lips, the fresher and tastier the meat!
:'''Bellano:''' Then an Acolyte from the Order visited the island and thought the name was unseemly, so he renamed them with a more scholarly term.
:'''Sofia:''' What's it called now?
:'''Bellano:''' —"'Til the Fin-ish!"
:'''Sofia:''' Ha, what a poetic name. Makes them sound even more delicious.
----
;<nowiki>(2:00 PM to 5:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Lyubov:''' Excuse me, could you get me this clam! And this wind chime too.
:'''Sergio:''' Alright, that'll be 220 [[Monnaie]].
:'''Lyubov:''' What? What's a Monnaie?
:'''Sofia:''' You're mistaken, Mister!
:'''Sofia:''' Monnaie is long outdated by now!
:'''Sofia:''' Now we use Shell Credit for payments as the rest of Solaris does. Monnaie has become just a souvenir of Ragunna.
:'''Sergio:''' Oh, yeah... you are right.
:'''Sergio:''' It feels like just yesterday we were still using Monnaie... I'm getting old...
:'''Sergio:''' Now I remember the time when Averardo Bank collected Monnaie to exchange new notes for us.
:'''Sergio:''' Oh, right, that'll be 220 Shell Credits, young lady.
{{Dialogue End}}
